# ENDOCARDITIS WITH CULTURE-NEGATIVE RESULTS

Cultures are often negative in cases of infection with fastidious organisms like Abiotrophia (formerly nutritionally variant Streptococci), Bartonella, Coxiella, Chlamydia, Legionella spp., or Trophyrema or when antimicrobials are given before blood cultures are obtained. Consult Infectious Diseases and Cardiology.

---
